items.title: What Does Incyte (INCY) First Patient Dosing Mean For Its Colorectal Cancer Pipeline?
items.summary: Incyte (NasdaqGS: INCY) and Adagene have started first patient dosing in a Phase 1 trial combining INCA33890 with muzastotug for microsatellite stable colorectal cancer. The early stage study is testing the investigational combination in a colorectal cancer subgroup where current immunotherapy options are limited.
